{{< irish poverty >}}

These pages show how many people in Ireland are at risk of poverty or cannot afford basic items, which groups are most affected, how many children live in low-income households, and how evenly income is shared, with comparisons with the rest of the EU. Household income is also covered in the [Economy](../economy/income.qmd) topic.
